route_title: Bounded Differential Evolution with 120-250nm Hard Constraints
compilation_rationale: Request compiles to a 20-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 alternating bandpass on fused silica. Differential evolution optimizer is mapped to allowed adam_lbfgs with hard-bound clamping per framework constraints. Coherent TMM spans 1300–1800 nm. Three mean-transmittance objectives enforce the passband maximization and dual stopband suppression. Downstream reporting of scores and thicknesses is deferred to execution.
